review.note:
Only one day of forecasts can be checked so far, and on that day they ran a little high, predicting a PSI of about 206 when the measured reading was 184, though still within the expected range. Even so, they were about twice as accurate as simply assuming the next day would match the latest reading. The most likely reason for the miss is a change in wind: by the day itself, less of Singapore's air was arriving from the big fire areas in Kalimantan and Sumatra and more from Java, where fires were smaller, so less smoke reached us even though Kalimantan's fires grew. One day is too little to justify changing the forecasts, so we are keeping them as they are and waiting for more results.
